name: Seeds Developer Helper
project_description: Seeds Developer Helper is a small developer-productivity module from the Seeds distribution ecosystem. It adds admin utilities that make image-style and form-display work faster: an image-style usage inspector that finds where each image style is referenced (responsive image styles, entity view displays, and exported config files) and lists unused styles; a one-click field-group generator that scaffolds a set of tabs/field groups on a content-type form display; a responsive-image test page that renders every responsive image style against a sample image; and a per-bundle field-label translation form. All of its routes live under the admin area and are gated by a single 'access seeds development' permission. It ships no dependencies of its own, but its features rely on core image/responsive_image and the contrib field_group module being present at runtime. Intended for development and staging environments rather than production.
